name: margin_curated_v1
description: Source-derived evaluation on five documents. Not an independent or general-accuracy benchmark. Topic-overlap flags are provisional and need review.

cases.question: How many credits are required for the MS Computer Science degree?
cases.expected_answer: 36 credits, equivalent to 12 courses.

cases.question: How many Category A courses are explicitly required?
cases.expected_answer: Two Category A courses.

cases.question: How many Category B courses are explicitly required?
cases.expected_answer: Two Category B courses.

cases.question: What is the maximum number of independent study courses among the four elective courses?
cases.expected_answer: At most two of those four courses.

cases.question: What minimum GPA does the MSCS document require?
cases.expected_answer: A minimum GPA of 3.

cases.question: How many grades of C or lower does the MSCS document permit?
cases.expected_answer: No more than two.

cases.question: What language must the essay or thesis use?
cases.expected_answer: English, except computer-language portions with English documentation.

cases.question: Which sections must the MSCS essay contain?
cases.expected_answer: Title, authors, abstract, and references.

cases.question: What grade must a previously submitted course paper have received to be used as the essay?
cases.expected_answer: B or higher.

cases.question: What must I provide if my essay was a group assignment?
cases.expected_answer: Cover pages detailing my contributions, along with the project report.

cases.question: Are presentation slides required with an essay submission?
cases.expected_answer: Yes, corresponding presentation slides are required.

cases.question: Do students receive extra credit for preparing the essay?
cases.expected_answer: No.

cases.question: Who must approve the MSCS essay?
cases.expected_answer: A Computer Science Graduate Faculty member, followed by the MS Director.

cases.question: How many credits of 198:704-706 must a thesis student register for?
cases.expected_answer: Exactly six credits.

cases.question: Who makes up the thesis committee?
cases.expected_answer: The thesis supervisor and two other faculty members selected in consultation with the supervisor.

cases.question: How should a student choose a thesis topic?
cases.expected_answer: By mutual agreement with the faculty supervisor.

cases.question: How will I know when an interlibrary loan item is ready?
cases.expected_answer: An email will notify me when it is ready for pickup or download.

cases.question: How are requested articles and book chapters delivered?
cases.expected_answer: Electronically.

cases.question: What should I do to see request options for an unavailable QuickSearch item?
cases.expected_answer: Sign in.

cases.question: Where can I receive requested materials other than articles and book chapters?
cases.expected_answer: At a Rutgers library of my choice or at home.

cases.question: What is the usual EZBorrow turnaround time?
cases.expected_answer: Usually three to five business days.

cases.question: How long is the EZBorrow loan period?
cases.expected_answer: 12 weeks.

cases.question: Which service should I try after QuickSearch and EZBorrow cannot find an item?
cases.expected_answer: ILLiad.

cases.question: What are first-time ILLiad users prompted to do?
cases.expected_answer: Register.

cases.question: Why are required textbooks unavailable through interlibrary loan?
cases.expected_answer: They are generally used as course reserves at their home institutions and are not eligible for loan.

cases.question: Where does the library page suggest students purchase or rent textbooks?
cases.expected_answer: The Rutgers University Bookstore.

cases.question: Can visitors from eduroam member institutions connect at Rutgers?
cases.expected_answer: Yes.

cases.question: What credentials should Rutgers users use when configuring eduroam?
cases.expected_answer: Their NetID and password.

cases.question: Who should Rutgers community members contact for eduroam connection problems?
cases.expected_answer: The Help Desk.

cases.question: Who should visiting students work with to set up eduroam?
cases.expected_answer: Their home institution.

cases.question: Which wireless service is identified for Rutgers community members on campus?
cases.expected_answer: RUWireless Secure.

cases.question: Which wireless service is identified for guests?
cases.expected_answer: RUWireless.

cases.question: How many digits are in the Duo identity confirmation code described on the page?
cases.expected_answer: Three.

cases.question: Approximately how long does signing up for two-step login take?
cases.expected_answer: About five minutes.

cases.question: Where are the two-step login help materials available?
cases.expected_answer: The knowledge base within the Rutgers IT Help portal.

cases.question: Where can I find Office video tutorials?
cases.expected_answer: LinkedIn Learning.

cases.question: Which listed Office applications are marked PC only?
cases.expected_answer: Publisher and Access.

cases.question: Can the Office installation allowance include personal equipment?
cases.expected_answer: Yes.

cases.question: Which storage service does the collected Office page recommend to students?
cases.expected_answer: Google Drive through their ScarletMail accounts.

cases.question: While what status does the Office license remain active?
cases.expected_answer: While enrolled in or employed at Rutgers.

cases.question: What is the exact graduation application deadline for spring 2027?
cases.expected_answer: The collected document does not provide that date.

cases.question: What is the tuition per credit for MS Computer Science?
cases.expected_answer: Tuition is not provided.

cases.question: What is the minimum GRE score for admission to MS Computer Science?
cases.expected_answer: Admission test requirements are not provided.

cases.question: What is the maximum number of online courses I can take in MSCS?
cases.expected_answer: The source refers to other policies but does not give this limit.

cases.question: What is the deadline for submitting my MSCS essay this semester?
cases.expected_answer: No specific essay submission deadline is supplied.

cases.question: Which professor is available to supervise my thesis this semester?
cases.expected_answer: Faculty availability is not supplied.

cases.question: How many credits are required for an MBA at Rutgers Newark?
cases.expected_answer: The MSCS credit policy does not establish MBA requirements.

cases.question: What GPA is required to graduate from the Newark MBA program?
cases.expected_answer: No MBA graduation policy is collected.

cases.question: Who approves a history master's thesis at Rutgers Camden?
cases.expected_answer: No history thesis policy is collected.

cases.question: What essay sections are required for an MBA at Rutgers Newark?
cases.expected_answer: The MSCS essay format does not establish MBA requirements.

cases.question: What is the overdue fine per day for an EZBorrow book?
cases.expected_answer: No overdue fine amount is supplied.

cases.question: How many times can I renew an EZBorrow loan?
cases.expected_answer: Renewal limits are not supplied.

cases.question: How much does home delivery of an interlibrary loan book cost?
cases.expected_answer: Home delivery is mentioned, but its price is not supplied.

cases.question: Can I request an interlibrary loan if I am an alumnus with no other Rutgers affiliation?
cases.expected_answer: The source does not explicitly establish alumni eligibility or ineligibility.

cases.question: What exact WiFi settings should I enter to configure eduroam on Windows 11?
cases.expected_answer: The collected page does not contain the detailed configuration steps.

cases.question: What download speed does Rutgers guarantee on eduroam?
cases.expected_answer: No guaranteed speed is supplied.

cases.question: What are the exact steps to transfer Duo to a replacement phone?
cases.expected_answer: A device guide is mentioned, but its procedural contents are not collected.

cases.question: How do I generate a Duo bypass code while traveling abroad?
cases.expected_answer: Travel and bypass help are mentioned without the procedure.

cases.question: Which minimum iOS version is required by Duo Mobile?
cases.expected_answer: The page suggests checking compatibility but gives no minimum version.

cases.question: How many gigabytes of Google Drive storage does my Rutgers account include?
cases.expected_answer: Google Drive is mentioned, but no storage quota is supplied.
